title: Post-COVID-Health Study: Multidimensional Health Status of COVID-19 Survivors One Year After a SARS-CoV-2 Infection
brief_summary: This study assesses the multidimensional health status of COVID-19 survivors one-year post-infection using validated subjective and objective measures.
study_population: All COVID-19 survivors of the MUMC+, VieCuri Medical Center or Zuyderland Medical Center can be included in this study. Both hospitalized (ICU and non-ICU admitted) as well as non-hospitalized patients will be eligible for participation.
